Ecosystem simulation: Wolf/Coyote/Eagle(nocturnal override)/Deer/Mouse as Animals + Grass as Plant; Hunter as non-animal Actor. Swing GUI, plain javac, NON-deterministic (no _verify harness, no golden-hash).

**Disease system:** DiseaseType enum (CONTACT/SEXUAL/FOODBORNE), Disease class with propagation+lethality rates; Organism base holds disease state (isDiseased/getDisease/setDisease).

**Refactor #1:** Extracted disease management from Animal into DiseaseManager component (composition). DiseaseManager holds: RANDOM_CONTRACTION_RATE, processRandomContraction(), checkContactSpread(), checkFoodborneSpread(), checkSexualSpread(), isLethalStep(). Animal.diseaseManager is `protected final` so Eagle (which overrides act()) can also delegate to it.

**Refactor #2:** Extracted SimulationEngine from Simulator. SimulationEngine owns: actors, field, step, environment, creationProbabilities, hunterCount, step()/reset()/populate()/plantGrassInPatches(). Simulator reduced to: view, playingSimulation/remainingSteps, button listeners, simulate()/simulateOneStep()/runLongSimulation()/reset() (delegates to engine + refreshes view via showCurrentStatus()). SimulationEngine exposes DEFAULT_DEPTH/DEFAULT_WIDTH as package-visible statics.

**Refactor #3:** Extracted FieldAnalyzer from Field. Field is now a pure container (place/clear/getObjectAt/getDepth/getWidth). FieldAnalyzer(Field) owns: adjacentLocations, randomAdjacentLocation, getFreeAdjacentLocations, freeAdjacentLocation, adjacentLocationsWithSpecies, getFreePatches, getRandomFreePatches. Organism gets getFieldAnalyzer() helper; all animal subclasses, Grass, Hunter, SimulationEngine updated to use FieldAnalyzer.

**Refactor #4:** Strategy pattern for population. PopulationStrategy interface (populate + getCreationProbabilities). DefaultPopulationStrategy holds creationProbabilities, HUNTER_LIMIT, resets hunterCount to 0 per populate() call (fixes latent reset bug). SimulationEngine removes map-based constructor, accepts PopulationStrategy; delegates populate() and probability access to strategy. Simulator(double...) updated to wrap map in DefaultPopulationStrategy.

**Refactor #5:** DiseaseAware interface decouples DiseaseManager from Animal. DiseaseAware defines isDiseased()/getDisease()/setDisease(); Organism implements it (setDisease widened protected→public). DiseaseManager now holds DiseaseAware host (was Animal); checkFoodborneSpread/checkSexualSpread params changed to DiseaseAware; checkContactSpread uses `obj instanceof DiseaseAware` guard (cleaner than `!(obj instanceof Hunter)`). No call-site changes needed — Animal/Organism already satisfy DiseaseAware.

**Refactor #6:** Extracted rendering and stats display from SimulatorView. FieldRenderer (JPanel) replaces nested FieldView: owns colors map, setColor/getColor/updateColorForClass, render(Field, FieldStats) which scans cells/accumulates stats/draws marks/calls repaint(). PopulationStatsPanel (JPanel) owns FieldStats, per-species JCheckBoxes (listeners call renderer.updateColorForClass), diseasedPopulation label; exposes updateDisplay()/syncColorsToRenderer()/getStats()/isViable(). SimulatorView reduced to: status labels, 4 buttons, addXxxButtonListener() methods, showStatus() (delegates to statsPanel.getStats().reset() → renderer.render() → statsPanel.updateDisplay() → syncColorsToRenderer()), isViable() → statsPanel.isViable(), setColor() → renderer.setColor(). Nested FieldView class deleted.

**Refactor #7:** Extracted viability rule from FieldStats into SimulationViabilityEvaluator. SimulationViabilityEvaluator.isViable(FieldStats) iterates SimulationInfo.ALL_ACTORS, counts non-zero species, returns nonZero > MIN_ALIVE_SPECIES (2). FieldStats.isViable(Field) deleted. PopulationStatsPanel gained a viabilityEvaluator field; isViable(Field) → isViable() (no-param, delegates to evaluator). SimulatorView.isViable(Field) kept its signature (callers unchanged) but now calls statsPanel.isViable() without forwarding Field.

**Refactor #8:** Extracted Time/Weather state transitions from SimulationEngine into EnvironmentManager. EnvironmentManager creates and owns the Environment internally (new Time, new Weather); exposes tick(int step) (calls time.incrementTime + weather.checkWeatherChange), reset() (calls time.reset only — weather not reset), and getEnvironment(). SimulationEngine.step() collapses two transition lines into environmentManager.tick(step) and resolves environment as a local for the actor loop; reset() delegates to environmentManager.reset(); getEnvironment() delegates to environmentManager.getEnvironment(). No callers outside the engine changed.
